notes: Only AU2612 since listing; AU2512 early-2025 history deferred. Not a two-year backtest.
36 exploratory combinations; chronological split is descriptive after inspection, not a pristine prospective test.
At most 1 signed lot; no forced daily trade; risk budget min(CNY3000, equity*1%). Stops use 1.5 closed-5m ATR and next available minute prices; gaps may exceed planned risk.
Margins 20% and fees CNY20 per side are editable research assumptions, not historical actual or broker terms. Stress uses 25%, CNY40, 4 ticks.

No limit order queue, bid/ask, tick path, exchange price-limit or real margin-history data; synthetic fills can be optimistic. Both stop/target touched in minute -> stop first. Zero-volume minutes cannot fill.
Daily settlement uses separate daily source at 15:00, for cash accounting only. Midnight does not reset trading day. Interval end marks open positions to market.
15/60-minute bars anchor each continuous exchange segment; final short buckets close at scheduled break. No unfinished candle enters signals.
Score is additive signal strength, not a probability. Missing macro contributes 0, no renormalization; technical-only theoretical max85. Patterns use confirmed pivots, not visual hindsight.
US rates use current-vintage FRED DGS10/DFII10 with 3 US federal business-day delay; conservative release proxy is not a point-in-time vintage guarantee. Macro variants remain experimental.
International news is not scored without archived event timestamps. Volume discrepancies (16 days, max68 lots) limit auxiliary factor evidence.
Day/night results attribute round-trip PnL to entry session; entry-window scenarios each use their own continuous 300k account, not additive returns.
